notes: V5.2.88 — Admin Gaming Mode test switch in the Performance Recorder (keeps the running game at High priority and lowers background apps, stays on after closing Opti Gods). Recordings save to Downloads automatically. CPU sensor button no longer fails when the driver is already installed. Performance Recorder works with any game: detects games from the built-in library, any game installed in Steam/Epic/Riot/EA/Ubisoft/GOG/Xbox folders, or the app using the GPU, and shows the right cover or the game's own icon (fixes the missing Fortnite logo). Fixes the FPS tile showing "No frames" (PresentMon frame column was not read) and adds clear feedback when the FPS counter downloads and starts. FiveM server box no longer shows "mumble" from voice chat; known servers are named automatically and a pencil lets you set your own name. Tweak audit now reads every registry value each tweak sets and shows applied or missing with the current and needed value, includes the detected game's own tweaks, and can copy missing values as a .reg file. Nothing is written by the audit.
